summary: Sequence sheets for AT-22 coated tablet stability and assay validation under WA/2024/211 for Aldrevessa Therapeutics: ICH chamber pulls to twelve months on coated and uncoated comparator tablets, with the HPLC method qualified for both. The uncoated comparator showed a humidity-driven increase in impurities; Aldrevessa selected the coated tablet for development.
